answer_1.quote: As a main evaluation task, we focus on paraphrase generation to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed PPR for conditional text generation, we experiment on the paraphrase generation task.
answer_1.outputs: paraphrases, machine translation outputs, image captions

answer_2.quote: We choose BERT-iBLEU, which is a reference-free metric capturing both semantic similarity (using BERTscore) and lexical dissimilarity (using iBLEU).

answer_4.quote: We performed example-wise comparison between randomly chosen outputs of PPR and BRIO/MLE trained models (generated by beam search with beam size of 16), asking the annotators to decide which one is a better paraphrase of the given source sentence, or if they are comparable in terms of faithfulness, lexical divergence and fluency.
answer_4.guideline: asking the annotators to decide which one is a better paraphrase of the given source sentence, or if they are comparable in terms of faithfulness, lexical divergence and fluency.
